issue.body:
#901 #875 

Perhaps extension of Request should be allowed instead of built-in `request.user` and the like.
Most of the time, users need their own authentication framework rather than using starlette, which will confuse the type hint. And, they are not used frequently, but there are many issues related to them. Deleting them may allow everyone to focus on the core functions.

@tomchristie What do you think?
issue.title: Consider removing `request.user` from HTTPConnection?
